## Summary
- What changed and why (compatibility update scope)
- Applications/OS affected

## Rule Changes
- Old envelope: min=___ max=___
- New envelope: min=___ max=___
- Diff classification: narrowing | widening | metadata-only | ambiguous
- Confidence: high | medium | low

## Evidence
- Vendor references (PCL, release notes, advisories) with quotes/locations
- Internal observations (if any, restrictive only)

## Tests
- Updated/added tests: GO, NO_GO, above-max, multi-app
- CI status

## Review Requirements
- If widening or confidence < high or ambiguity detected: manual approval required
